method: Restart Convertigo for each stage, wait for the provider preload in P3, then call sample_HelloWorld_flow.GetFeed against the same local RSS fixture without external network I/O.

steps.change: AutoStart warmups removed; no global block artifact cache
Global compiled block artifacts keyed by provider QName, source and compiler fingerprint
Rejected hook: preload from every consumer FlowEngine
steps.reasonRejected: Concurrent preloads serialized on the shared Rhino runtime and delayed the first request.

steps.change: Preload only from the FlowEngine project that owns the engine QName

conclusion: The cold delay is primarily Flow catalog and compilation work. A single provider-owned preload plus globally reusable block artifacts removes about three quarters of the first application request without an AutoStart sequence or external I/O.
